checks.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'rtk node --check packages/create-expo-base-app/bin/create-expo-base-app.mjs && rtk node --check scripts/golden-catalog-lib.mjs && rtk node --check scripts/golden-pattern-lib.mjs && rtk git diff --check'

/bin/zsh -lc 'tmpdir=$(rtk mktemp -d /tmp/expo-base-chg102.XXXXXX | tail -n 1) && rtk node packages/create-expo-base-app/bin/create-expo-base-app.mjs --name '"'Manual Ledger' --slug manual-ledger --directory \""'$tmpdir" && rtk find "$tmpdir" -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | sed -n '"'1,120p' && printf '%s\\n' '--- contract escape scan ---' && rtk rg -n '\\.\\./\\.\\./(?:AGENTS|docs|scripts|packages|tsconfig\\.base)' \""'$tmpdir" || true && printf '"'%s\\n' '--- package set ---' && rtk node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); console.log(fs.readdirSync('"'$tmpdir/packages'"').sort())\" && printf '%s\\n' '--- provenance ---' && rtk sed -n '1,120p' \""'$tmpdir/.expo-base/source.json" && printf '"'%s\\n' '--- package ---' && rtk sed -n '1,180p' \""'$tmpdir/package.json"'

/bin/zsh -lc 'tmpdir=$(rtk mktemp -d /tmp/expo-base-chg102.XXXXXX | tail -n 1) && rtk node packages/create-expo-base-app/bin/create-expo-base-app.mjs --name '"'Manual Ledger' --slug manual-ledger --directory \""'$tmpdir" && printf '"'%s\\n' '--- package files ---' && rtk find \""'$tmpdir" -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | sed -n '"'1,140p' && printf '%s\\n' '--- contract escape scan ---' && rtk rg -n '\\.\\./\\.\\./(?:AGENTS|docs|scripts|packages|tsconfig\\.base)' \""'$tmpdir" || true && printf '"'%s\\n' '--- package set ---' && rtk node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); console.log(fs.readdirSync('"'$tmpdir/packages'"').sort())\" && printf '%s\\n' '--- provenance ---' && rtk sed -n '1,120p' \""'$tmpdir/.expo-base/source.json" && printf '"'%s\\n' '--- package ---' && rtk sed -n '1,180p' \""'$tmpdir/package.json"'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk nl -ba scripts/test-generator.mjs | sed -n '1,35p' && rtk node packages/create-expo-base-app/bin/create-expo-base-app.mjs --name 'Orbit Ledger' --slug orbit-ledger --accent violet --link-host app.example.com --mode workspace --directory apps/.tmp-debug-generator"
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk tsc -p apps/.tmp-debug-generator/tsconfig.json --noEmit; printf 'exit=%s\\n' "'$? && rtk git status --short'
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk test -e node_modules/.bin/tsc; echo tscbin=$?; rtk which tsc || true; rtk npm exec -- tsc --version'
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk test -f package-lock.json; rtk ls node_modules/typescript/package.json node_modules/react/package.json 2>/dev/null || true; rtk git status --short | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git status --short && printf '%s\\n' '--- diff stat ---' && rtk git diff --stat && printf '%s\\n' '--- generator diff snippets ---' && rtk git diff -- packages/create-expo-base-app/bin/create-expo-base-app.mjs scripts/test-generator.mjs scripts/golden-catalog-lib.mjs scripts/golden-pattern-lib.mjs | sed -n '1,360p'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk npm run golden:patterns:write && rtk npm run check:golden-patterns && rtk git diff -- docs/GOLDEN_WORKFLOWS.md'
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk npm run golden:patterns:write && rtk npm run check:golden-patterns && rtk git diff -- docs/GOLDEN_WORKFLOWS.md scripts/golden-pattern-lib.mjs'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git status --short && rtk git diff --check && rtk npm run check:golden-architecture && rtk npm run check:package-manifests && rtk npm run check:public-api && rtk npm run api:snapshot:check'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git diff --check && rtk node --check packages/create-expo-base-app/bin/create-expo-base-app.mjs && rtk node --check scripts/golden-pattern-lib.mjs && rtk node --check scripts/golden-catalog-lib.mjs && rtk git diff --stat'
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk npm run typecheck && rtk git diff --check && rtk git status --short --branch && rtk git diff --stat'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git diff -- README.md docs/GENERATOR.md docs/PORTABILITY.md docs/SCREEN_SCAFFOLDING.md scripts/golden-catalog-lib.mjs scripts/golden-pattern-lib.mjs | sed -n '1,420p' && printf '%s\\n' '--- generator standalone diff ---' && rtk git diff -- packages/create-expo-base-app/bin/create-expo-base-app.mjs | sed -n '1,520p' && printf '%s\\n' '--- test diff ---' && rtk git diff -- scripts/test-generator.mjs | sed -n '1,360p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git status --short --branch && rtk git diff --check && rtk git diff --numstat && printf '%s\\n' '--- no generated temp artifacts ---' && rtk find apps -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '.tmp-*' -print"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git add README.md docs/GENERATOR.md docs/PORTABILITY.md docs/SCREEN_SCAFFOLDING.md packages/create-expo-base-app/bin/create-expo-base-app.mjs scripts/golden-catalog-lib.mjs scripts/golden-pattern-lib.mjs scripts/test-generator.mjs && rtk git commit -m "feat(generator): emit standalone product repositories"'
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git status --short --branch && rtk git log -1 --format='%H%n%s' && rtk npm run test:generator"
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git status --short --branch && rtk git rev-parse HEAD && rtk git show --stat --oneline --decorate HEAD'
